description: This Java source file defines a functional interface 'EventSniffer' used for sniffing events over websocket or SSE, providing methods to create sinks and async flows for event processing. It also includes an inner static class 'NoOp' implementing a no-operation event sniffer.

classes.name: EventSniffer
classes.description: A functional interface for sniffing events over websocket or Server-Sent Events (SSE).

classes.name: EventSniffer.NoOp
classes.description: A static inner class implementing a no-operation event sniffer that ignores all events.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink that receives events of type T, given an HTTP request.

methods.name: toAsyncFlow
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous flow that wiretaps events for sniffing, returning a flow that passes through events unchanged.

methods.name: noOp
methods.description: Returns an EventSniffer that performs no operation, with events being ignored.
